question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

WITH first_term AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        MIN(term_start) as first_start,
        MIN(term_number) as first_term_number
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY id_bioguide, state
),
target_years AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        first_start,
        0 as years_offset,
        CAST(first_start AS DATE) + 0 as target_date
    FROM first_term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        first_start,
        2 as years_offset,
        CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '2' YEAR as target_date
    FROM first_term
    WHERE CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '2' YEAR <= CAST('2050-12-31' AS DATE)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        first_start,
        4 as years_offset,
        CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '4' YEAR as target_date
    FROM first_term
    WHERE CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '4' YEAR <= CAST('2050-12-31' AS DATE)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        first_start,
        6 as years_offset,
        CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '6' YEAR as target_date
    FROM first_term
    WHERE CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '6' YEAR <= CAST('2050-12-31' AS DATE)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        first_start,
        8 as years_offset,
        CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '8' YEAR as target_date
    FROM first_term
    WHERE CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '8' YEAR <= CAST('2050-12-31' AS DATE)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        first_start,
        10 as years_offset,
        CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '10' YEAR as target_date
    FROM first_term
    WHERE CAST(first_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '10' YEAR <= CAST('2050-12-31' AS DATE)
),
retained AS (
    SELECT 
        ty.id_bioguide,
        ty.state,
        ty.target_date,
        ty.years_offset,
        CAST(l.gender AS VARCHAR) as gender,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide 
                AND lt.state = ty.state
                AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= ty.target_date
                AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= ty.target_date
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END as retained
    FROM target_years ty
    JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = ty.id_bioguide
),
retention_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        years_offset,
        COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
        SUM(retained) as retained_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND SUM(retained) > 0 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END as has_positive_retention
    FROM retained
    GROUP BY state, gender, years_offset
),
all_time_points AS (
    SELECT 0 as years_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
gender_time_points AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        years_offset,
        has_positive_retention
    FROM retention_stats
    WHERE state IS NOT NULL AND gender IN ('M', 'F')
),
mvp AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        years_offset,
        has_positive_retention,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state, gender ORDER BY years_offset) as rn
    FROM gender_time_points
),
all_points_males AS (
    SELECT state FROM mvp WHERE gender = 'M' AND has_positive_retention = 1 GROUP BY state HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT years_offset) = 6
),
all_points_females AS (
    SELECT state FROM mvp WHERE gender = 'F' AND has_positive_retention = 1 GROUP BY state HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT years_offset) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT apm.state
FROM all_points_males apm
JOIN all_points_females apf ON apm.state = apf.state
ORDER BY apm.state
